name: ICOMAT
oneLine: UK composites manufacturer whose site turns its fiber-steering process into generative line art and mono-labelled technical panels.

palette.note: Charcoal hero field behind the animated vertical fiber lines
Off-white body background for the RTS explainer and comparison panels
Near-black 'How we operate' section and 3D part render panels
Cool blue-grey light text, the most frequent text color; fades to 50% and 27% alpha for scroll-reveal paragraphs
Body ink on the light sections
Electric green fiber strands in the hero canvas, with rare magenta (#B859B3) strands as counterpoint

type.family: Lay Grotesk (Semibold cut, rendered at weight 400)
type.note: 73px hero 'Engineer Without Limits', two lines, tight -2% tracking, sentence case, bottom-left anchored; 48px for big statement paragraphs
~18px semibold-looking body, tight leading (~1.05), second sentence set at 50% alpha as a lighter sub-claim
11-12px uppercase nav (SOLUTIONS / TECH / INDUSTRIES) and panel captions like 'RTS / STEERED FIBER COMPOSITES'
Pixel/dot font used sparingly (7 nodes) for numeric or technical callouts

layout: Full-bleed hero split into a bottom-left headline and a mid-right 2-line claim, leaving ~70% of the viewport to the animated line field.
Light sections use a 12-column grid with tiny 4px square registration dots marking column edges at the top, plus hairline-bordered panels with corner ticks like a drawing sheet.
Dark sections run wide 48px statement paragraphs edge-to-edge, followed by a 2-up rounded-corner image grid at 20px gutters.
motion: Hero is a canvas of vertical fiber strands in green/magenta that (inferred) drift and shear horizontally, visualizing Rapid Tow Shearing.
Large statement paragraph reveals word-by-word on scroll: words already passed are bright #CFD9E0, upcoming words are dimmed to ~27-50% alpha.
(inferred) Straight-vs-steered fiber comparison panels animate from straight to curved fiber paths as they enter view; panels appear blank mid-load in the capture.
(inferred) 3D carbon part renders on canvas (5 canvases, 5 videos on page) rotate with scroll inside the dark gridded frame.
interactions: Floating pill nav in a black rounded bar with a white inverted 'BUILD W/ ICOMAT' primary button.
Square scroll-down arrow button pinned bottom-right of the hero.
Before/after comparison cards ('BEFORE RTS' / 'RTS DESIGN') with circular toggle icons.
steal: Scroll-scrubbed word-by-word brightness reveal for our research-question statement paragraph between the hero and the methods section.
Registration-dot column markers and hairline panels with corner ticks as the frame for each telemetry chart card on the results page.
A generative hero canvas of vertical lines driven by actual telemetry channels (one strand per sensor, anomalies flare in accent color) instead of stock space imagery.
leave: The neon green plus magenta strand mix: it reads as glitch art and would compete with our anomaly-highlight accent, which must be the only loud color.
Panels that stay blank until heavy canvas/JS loads; our figures should render static SVG first and animate on top.
